recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Geography for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Iwena
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Regional Geography of Nigeria: Relief and Drainage Basins
subtopics: Broad physical relief regions: North-Central plateau (Jos Plateau), Eastern highlands, Western highlands, Coastal plains, Chad basin
Drainage systems: The Niger-Benue drainage basin, inland drainage of Lake Chad, short coastal rivers
River regimes: Single peak vs double peak flood hydrographs, and seasonal river navigability
objectives: Sketch an outline map of Nigeria showing the 5 major relief units
Analyze economic benefits of River Niger and River Benue (hydro-electricity at Kainji, irrigation, fishing)
Explain why Lake Chad has drastically shrunk in surface area over recent decades

topics.topic: Climate and Vegetation Zones of Nigeria
subtopics: Air masses affecting Nigeria: Tropical Maritime (cT) moist south-westerly winds vs Tropical Continental (cT) dry North-East trade winds (Harmattan)
The Inter-Tropical Discontinuity (ITD) and rainfall distribution across Nigeria
Vegetation belts: Mangrove swamp, fresh water swamp, rainforest, Guinea savanna, Sudan savanna, Sahel savanna
objectives: Explain the seasonal migration of the Inter-Tropical Discontinuity (ITD)
Compare plant adaptations of the rainforest (buttress roots, epiphytes) with the Sahel savanna (acacia thorns, deep roots)
Evaluate deforestation and desertification mitigation projects like the Great Green Wall

topics.topic: Mineral and Energy Resources of Nigeria
subtopics: Petroleum and natural gas in the Niger Delta and offshore continental shelf
Solid minerals: Coal in Enugu, tin and columbite on Jos Plateau, limestone across Benue and Ogun, iron ore at Itakpe
Renewable energy potential: Solar radiation in Northern Nigeria, hydro-power sites
objectives: Map location sites of 6 major economic mineral deposits across Nigeria
Analyze socio-economic and environmental consequences of petroleum extraction and gas flaring in the Niger Delta
Propose strategies to modernize artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) operations

topics.topic: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Remote Sensing
subtopics: Basic concepts of GIS: Hardware, software, spatial data (vector vs raster), and attribute tables
Remote sensing principles: Satellites, spectral bands, orbital paths, and aerial photographic interpretation
Applications in Nigeria: Urban planning in Lagos, flood hazard monitoring, crop yield estimation, mineral exploration
objectives: Differentiate vector data models (points, lines, polygons) from raster grid cells in GIS
Explain how satellite imagery detects real-time coastal erosion in Victoria Island, Lagos
Outline procedures for digitizing topographical land parcels into GIS databases
